notes.title: 中国人 in Earthquake Margarita School
notes.content:
[h2]We are pleased to announce that in this update, [b]Chinese[/b] has been added as a new available language in Earthquake: Margarita School.[/h2]

Thank you for continuing to trust us, and we hope this improvement makes your experience even more accessible for everyone!

notes.title: UI & Notes Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] We have improved the interface to make it clearer and easier to use.
[/list] 
[list]
[*] Additionally, we added new notes and clues that reveal more about the school's dark past, including details about the earthquake and the disappearance of the librarian.
[/list]

Thank you for playing Earthquake Margarita School!

notes.title: New Update on gameplay
notes.content:
[h1]New update[/h1]
Focused on polishing gameplay:

[list]
[*] We’ve improved mechanics
[/list] 

[list]
[*] Adjusted pacing 
[/list]

[list]
[*] Redesigned parts of the level so each area feels more intense, smoother, and atmospheric.
[/list]

notes.title: Quick Fixes After the Stream – Thank You!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [h2][b]Critical bug fixed[/b][/h2]
The bug that caused a black screen after saving and restarting has been fixed. The save and respawn system is now much more stable and reliable.
[/list]

[list]
[*][h2] [b]Updated controls[/b][/h2]
Sprint is no longer mapped to Ctrl, and crouch is no longer Shift. Both have been reassigned to make the controls feel more intuitive from the start.
[/list]


[list]
[*] [h2][b]AI voice removed[/b][/h2]
The AI-generated voiceover has been completely removed. I originally thought it sounded natural, but I now realize it could break immersion. I'd rather have no voice at all than something that feels artificial.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [h2]Coming soon: Replacing AI-generated art[/h2]
Some placeholder art created with AI will be replaced by hand-drawn illustrations. It was a temporary solution due to time limits, but I'm already working on original replacements.
[/list]

Thanks again to everyone who shared feedback, and for supporting this indie project. See you in the next update!

— PAPU'S STUDIO

notes.title: Earthquake Margarita School - Definitive Edition
notes.content: [h2][b]EARTHQUAKE MARGARITA SCHOOL is now free![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]That’s why we’ve decided to add a new update that is practically a whole new game![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This update marks a turning point: it’s basically a complete [b]remaster[/b] of the game, with an [b]updated story[/b], [b]voice-acted dialogues[/b], [b]improved graphics[/b], [b]optimizations[/b], [b]gameplay adjustments[/b], [b]bug fixes[/b], and [b]new environments.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206465/1d3ae208d71d47a1c3edab93c625f446711f22cd.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]Every aspect has been revamped to offer you a much more polished and enjoyable experience.[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: Earthquake Margarita School Free
notes.content: [h1]🎒 Earthquake Margarita School will be completely FREE starting June 16th 🎒[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206465/f5a20b4ee5940d9c3b7c499a93453180b3ce202d.png"][/img][/p][p]On that day, the game will receive a major update that will completely transform it.[/p][p]📚 What does this new version include?[/p][p]🏞️ A new beginning: The story now begins in a forest at dusk, with a subtle tutorial as you climb toward the abandoned school.[/p][p]🔊 Remastered sound: Realistic and balanced 3D effects for a much more immersive atmosphere.[/p][p]✍️ Improved story: More polished dialogue, better-connected events, and a clearer narrative.[/p][p]⚙️ Better optimization: Smoother gameplay on all types of PCs.[/p][p]💾 Save game option: Play at your own pace without losing your progress.[/p][p]👁️‍🗨️ Visual improvements and new details in environments, lighting, and settings.[/p][p]🌪️ If you've already played it, this version is almost a new game.[/p][p]🎮 If you haven't played it, now's the perfect time: it'll be free forever.[/p][p][/p][h2]📅 Available June 16 on Steam.[/h2]

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]New Update Available![/b][/u][/h1]
[previewyoutube=vzWKxmWhqok;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to share with you the latest update of our game, [b]Earthquake: Margarita School[/b]. We've worked hard to improve your experience.

[b]What's New in the Update:[/b]

The issue with incorrect collisions has been resolved.
Visual glitches that appeared over distances have been eliminated.
These fixes allow for better immersion and enhance your ability to enjoy the graphical environment.

[b]Performance Optimization[/b]

We've improved the game's performance by reducing loading times and fixing bugs that impacted fluidity.

[b]Interaction Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue where players could interact with objects that weren’t being aimed at. Now, interaction works only with objects you're directly pointing at.
[b]General Audio Enhancements[/b]

Audio depth and quality have been improved overall.
[b]New Horror Scenes and Details Not Included in Previous Versions[/b]

Immerse yourself in an even more terrifying experience with visual and auditory effects that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

[b]Story Enhancements[/b]

New clues and documents have been added to enrich the narrative.
Discover more about the dark past of Margarita School!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206465/1d3ae208d71d47a1c3edab93c625f446711f22cd.png[/img]

⚠️ [b]Technical Changes:[/b]

Better handling of missing materials and assets to prevent loading errors.
Fixed an issue where animations remained active while the character was idle.

[b]Download the Update Now[/b]

Don't miss this new and improved version that makes the game much more immersive and enjoyable! Download it now and continue exploring the mysteries of Margarita School.

Thank you for your support and for being part of our community. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to leave us a comment!
